objective: Migrate the four primary acquisition-performance created-at report surfaces onto canonical cohort resolution and expose explicit nested cohort completeness metadata without changing their existing performance denominators.

semantics.omittedLimit: complete requested created-at range through bounded keyset pages
semantics.relationshipCount: preserve each report's existing relationship-count meaning
semantics.conversionMaturity: matureRelationshipCount and immatureRelationshipCount remain conversion-window evidence semantics and are not replaced by cohort size

rules: All four reports delegate cohort selection to resolveInsuranceCreatedAtReportCohort.
Each public limit?: number input remains unchanged.
Cohort resolution completes before any economics, outcome, presentation, or raw-evidence read.
Existing evidence/economics/outcome read counts remain unchanged after cohort resolution.
Lifetime empty-cohort short-circuit behavior remains intact.
As-of, conversion-window, and curve raw-evidence behavior remains intact.

No OFFSET or unbounded SQL is introduced.
No schema or migration is added or executed.
